verses.text: So get rid of all evil, all lying, pretending, jealousy and all unkind talk.
Like newborn babies, long for the pure milk of God's word, so that it can help you grow,
now that you have tasted how good the Lord is.
Come to Jesus. He is the living stone that people threw away, but God chose him as precious.
You also are like living stones, being built into a house where God's Spirit lives. You are a holy group of priests, offering spiritual sacrifices that please God through Jesus Christ.
For the Scripture says, "Look, I am placing a stone in Zion, a chosen and precious cornerstone. Anyone who trusts in him will never be put to shame."
For you who believe, this stone is precious. But for those who do not believe, "The stone the builders rejected has become the most important stone."
And, "It is a stone that makes people trip, and a rock that makes them fall." They trip because they do not obey God's message, and that is what was planned for them.

But you are God's chosen people, royal priests, a holy nation, people who belong to God. He called you out of darkness into his wonderful light, so that you can tell others about the great things he has done.
Once you were not God's people, but now you are. Once you had not received mercy, but now you have received God's mercy.
Dear friends, you are like foreigners and visitors in this world. So I beg you, stay away from the wrong desires of the body, which fight against your soul.
Live such good lives among people who do not know God that, even if they accuse you of doing wrong, they will see the good things you do. Then they will praise God on the day he comes.
For the Lord's sake, obey every human authority: the king, who is the highest,
and the governors he sends to punish those who do wrong and to praise those who do right.
God wants you to do good, so that you will stop foolish people from saying ignorant things.
Live as free people, but do not use your freedom as an excuse to do evil. Live as God's servants.
Respect everyone. Love your fellow believers. Honour God. Respect the king.
Slaves, obey your masters with full respect, not only those who are good and kind, but also those who are cruel.
God is pleased when you put up with pain, suffering for something you did not deserve, because you are thinking of God.
What credit is there if you are beaten for doing wrong and you put up with it? But if you suffer for doing good and you put up with it, God is pleased with you.
God called you to this, because Christ also suffered for you. He left you an example, so that you would follow in his footsteps.
"He never sinned, and he never told a lie."
When people insulted him, he did not insult them back. When he suffered, he did not threaten anyone. He trusted himself to God, who judges fairly.
He himself carried our sins in his body on the cross, so that we would die to sin and live for what is right. You have been healed by his wounds.
You were like sheep that wandered away, but now you have come back to the Shepherd who takes care of your souls.
